# 74245 - Octal bus transceiver with 3-state outputs

Package DIP-20 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74245.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74245.json)

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | DIR | input |  |  | direction: low = B to A, high = A to B |
| 2 | A1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B1) when DIR is low and OE is low |
| 3 | A2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B2) when DIR is low and OE is low |

| 6 | A5 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B5) when DIR is low and OE is low |
| 7 | A6 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B6) when DIR is low and OE is low |
| 8 | A7 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B7) when DIR is low and OE is low |
| 9 | A8 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is high, output (B8) when DIR is low and OE is low |
| 10 | GND | ground |  |  |  |

| 13 | B6 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A6) when DIR is high and OE is low |
| 14 | B5 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A5) when DIR is high and OE is low |
| 15 | B4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A4) when DIR is high and OE is low |
| 16 | B3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A3) when DIR is high and OE is low |
| 17 | B2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A2) when DIR is high and OE is low |
| 18 | B1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by 19, 1; bidirectional: input when DIR is low, output (A1) when DIR is high and OE is low |
| 19 | OE | enable | low |  | controls pins 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 18, 17, 16, 15, 14, 13, 12, 11; when not enabled: float; output enable; high = all channels disabled (high impedance), the buses are isolated |
| 20 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | A1 = (OE' AND DIR') ? B1 : Z | A1 drives B1 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance. |
| 18 | B1 = (OE' AND DIR) ? A1 : Z | B1 drives A1 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance. |
| 3 | A2 = (OE' AND DIR') ? B2 : Z | A2 drives B2 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance. |
| 17 | B2 = (OE' AND DIR) ? A2 : Z | B2 drives A2 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance. |
| 4 | A3 = (OE' AND DIR') ? B3 : Z | A3 drives B3 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance. |
| 16 | B3 = (OE' AND DIR) ? A3 : Z | B3 drives A3 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance. |
| 5 | A4 = (OE' AND DIR') ? B4 : Z | A4 drives B4 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance. |
| 15 | B4 = (OE' AND DIR) ? A4 : Z | B4 drives A4 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance. |
| 6 | A5 = (OE' AND DIR') ? B5 : Z | A5 drives B5 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance. |
| 14 | B5 = (OE' AND DIR) ? A5 : Z | B5 drives A5 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance. |
| 7 | A6 = (OE' AND DIR') ? B6 : Z | A6 drives B6 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance. |
| 13 | B6 = (OE' AND DIR) ? A6 : Z | B6 drives A6 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance. |
| 8 | A7 = (OE' AND DIR') ? B7 : Z | A7 drives B7 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance. |
| 12 | B7 = (OE' AND DIR) ? A7 : Z | B7 drives A7 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance. |
| 9 | A8 = (OE' AND DIR') ? B8 : Z | A8 drives B8 while OE and DIR are low; otherwise high impedance. |
| 11 | B8 = (OE' AND DIR) ? A8 : Z | B8 drives A8 while OE is low and DIR is high; otherwise high impedance. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 24 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -15 |
| inputSchmitt | yes |
| hysteresisV | 0.4 |
| notes | SN74LS245 figures (pages 3-5). A and B inputs have hysteresis 0.2 V min, 0.4 V typ (page 5); thresholds not given. Off-state current 20 uA high, -200 uA low. |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A or B | B or A | PLH | 8 | 12 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF |
| A or B | B or A | PHL | 8 | 12 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF |
| OE | any A or B | PZL | 27 | 40 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF |
| OE | any A or B | PZH | 25 | 40 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 45 pF |
| OE | any A or B | PLZ | 15 | 25 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 5 pF |
| OE | any A or B | PHZ | 15 | 28 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 667 ohm, CL 5 pF |

## Not known

- The switching table (page 5) does not name the from/to pins; port to port for tPLH/tPHL and OE for the enable/disable times are taken from what those times mean.
- The datasheet gives no delay for a change of DIR alone.
- vtPlusV and vtMinusV: only the hysteresis is given.

## Notes

A and B pins are both inputs and outputs; they are listed with role output (three-state) as the 8553 file does. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS245.

## Sources

- [TI SN54LS245/SN74LS245 datasheet SDLS146B (October 1976, revised September 2016)](https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/sn74ls245.pdf) - 1, 3, 4, 5; SN74LS245
